IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Education Appropriations & Oversight (originally sponsored by Representatives Hasegawa, Kenney, Santos, McCoy, Moscoso, Sells, Carlyle, Reykdal, Seaquist, Jacks, Probst, Maxwell, and Ormsby)

Bill.BriefDescription: Changing state need grant eligibility provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state need grant eligibility; and amending RCW28B.92.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.92.080 and 2009 c 238 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except for opportunity internship graduates whose eligibility isprovided under RCW 28B.92.084, for a student to be eligible for a stateneed grant a student must: (1) Be a "needy student" or "disadvantaged student" as determinedby the board in accordance with RCW 28B.92.030 (((3))) (2) and (((4)))(5); (2) Have been domiciled within the state of Washington for at leastone year; (3) Be enrolled or accepted for enrollment ((on at least a halftime basis)) for at least three quarter credits or the equivalentsemester credits at an institution of higher education in Washington asdefined in RCW 28B.92.030(((1))) (4); and (4) ((Until June 30, 2011, to the extent funds are specificallyappropriated for this purpose, and subject to any terms and conditions p. 1 SHB 1650specified in the omnibus appropriations act, be enrolled or acceptedfor enrollment for at least three quarter credits or the equivalentsemester credits at an institution of higher education in Washington asdefined in RCW 28B.92.030(1); and (5))) Have complied with all the rules adopted by the board for theadministration of this chapter.
